trust_decision.summary: Node parameters typed as strings (text/html, also address fields) are passed unchecked into nodemailer mail options, where an object value is treated as a content object ({path}/{href}) that nodemailer resolves from the local filesystem or a URL; the decision of whether workflow-supplied message content may name files/URLs is made (not at all) in the Send Email node before transporter.sendMail / createTransport.

landing_point.why: Advisory names the Send Email node; the current (v2) send operation is where text/html are read with getNodeParameter and copied into mailOptions without type coercion.
